# Queue one subject-root audit after any appointment-wrapper call.
# No appointment value written by that call is read in the same effect chain.
zg361_we_queue_m274_appointment_ack_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_m274_native_resume_status
	if = {
		limit = {
			this = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ EXPECTED_STATE = 4
			}
			$TICKET_OWNER$ = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m274_native_resume_audit_scheduled }
				var:zg361_we_m274_native_resume_audit_scheduled = 0
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_native_resume_pending_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_native_resume_pending_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_native_resume_pending_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_native_resume_pending_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361we.5370 days = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_native_resume_status value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_native_resume_audit_scheduled value = 1 } # commit last
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_we_m274_native_resume_audit_scheduled = 1
			var:zg361_we_m274_native_resume_pending_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_we_m274_native_resume_pending_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_we_m274_native_resume_pending_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$

		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_native_resume_status value = 5 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_native_resume_status value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_native_resume_red_code value = 27490 }
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_attribution_debt_registered_due_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m269_debt_attribution_due_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_attribution_debt_registered_escalation value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_attribution_debt_registered value = 1 }
		zg361_we_ad_schedule_stage_06_deadline_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_debt_attribution_status value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_debt_attribution_pending value = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_debt_attribution_status value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_debt_attribution_red_code value = 26953 }
	}
}

# D+1 post-settlement seam for rehire-history integration.  It proves state 6
# on a second frame, captures eligible external growth, or prepares #276 after
# the subject later returns to the immutable old owner.
zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_handoff_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_status
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_pending
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_phase
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_owner
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_subject
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_case
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_outcome_settled
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_outcome_pending
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_write_owner
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_write_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_write_case
			has_variable = zg361_case_ad_state
			var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_pending = 1
			var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_phase = 1
			var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_subject = this
			var:zg361_case_ad_state = 5
			var:zg361_we_m269_outcome_settled = 1
			var:zg361_we_m269_outcome_pending = 0
			var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_owner = var:zg361_we_m269_write_owner
			var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_cycle = var:zg361_we_m269_write_cycle
			var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_case = var:zg361_we_m269_write_case
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_attribution_signature_receipt_id
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_attribution_signature_receipt_hash
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_phase value = 2 }
		zg361_workforce_probation_fact_finalize_consumption_receipt_effect = yes
		zg361_case_ad_advance_05_effect = {
			TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_owner TICKET_SUBJECT = this
			TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_cycle
			TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_case
		}
		trigger_event = { id = zg361we.5377 days = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_status value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_pending
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_phase
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_owner
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_subject
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_case
			has_variable = zg361_case_ad_state
			has_variable = zg361_case_ad_owner
			has_variable = zg361_case_ad_subject
			has_variable = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
			has_variable = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_pending = 1
			var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_phase = 2
			var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_subject = this
			var:zg361_case_ad_state = 6
			var:zg361_case_ad_owner = var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_owner
			var:zg361_case_ad_subject = this
			var:zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial = var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_cycle
			var:zg361_case_ad_case_serial = var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_case
		}
		zg361_we_ad_schedule_stage_06_deadline_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_state
				var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_state = 1
			}
			zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_capture_growth_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_state
				has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_published
				has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consumed
				has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_exit_owner
				var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_state = 2
				var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_published = 1
				var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consumed = 0
				var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_exit_owner = var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_owner
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_owner value = var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_owner }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_subject value = this }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_cycle }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_case value = var:zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_case }
			zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_prepare_m276_effect = yes
			trigger_event = { id = zg361we.5379 days = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_pending value = 1 } # commit last
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_ready value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_status value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_pending value = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_status value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_postsettlement_red_code value = 26961 }
	}
}

# D+1 gate between the source package's prepare write and the visible/AI #276
# operation.  Ordinary subjects without a sealed rehire history never enter it.
zg361_we_m276_audit_prepared_rehire_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_status
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_pending
			has_variable = zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_owner
			has_variable = zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_subject
			has_variable = zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_case
			var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_pending = 1
			var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_subject = this
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_owner EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_case EXPECTED_STATE = 6
			}
			has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_state
			has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_published
			has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_prepared_owner
			has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_prepared_subject
			has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_prepared_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_prepared_case
			var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_state = 3
			var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_published = 1
			var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consumed = 0
			var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_prepared_owner = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_owner
			var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_prepared_subject = this
			var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_prepared_cycle = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_cycle
			var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_prepared_case = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_case
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_pending value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_status value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_owner = { is_ai = yes } }
			zg361_we_m276_route_a_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_owner TICKET_SUBJECT = this
				TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_case
			}
			zg361_we_queue_m276_rehire_finalize_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_owner TICKET_SUBJECT = this
				TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_case CHOICE = 1
			}
		}
		else = {
			var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_we_ad_owner }
			save_scope_as = zg361_we_ad_subject
			save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ad_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_cycle }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ad_case value = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_case }
			var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_prepare_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361we.276 } }
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_status value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_red_code value = 27661 }
	}
}

# Route A/B writes are observed only by a later subject event.  Route C never
# calls this queue because it has not consumed the rehire history.
zg361_we_queue_m276_rehire_finalize_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_status
	if = {
		limit = {
			this = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ EXPECTED_STATE = 6
			}
			OR = { $CHOICE$ = 1 $CHOICE$ = 2 }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_pending }
				var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_pending = 0
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_choice value = $CHOICE$ }
		if = {
			limit = { $TICKET_OWNER$ = { is_ai = yes } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_mode value = 2 }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_mode value = 1 } }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361we.5380 days = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_status value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_pending value = 1 } # commit last
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_pending = 1
			var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_choice = $CHOICE$
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_status value = 5 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_status value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_red_code value = 27662 }
	}
}

zg361_we_m276_finalize_rehire_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_status
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_pending = 1
			var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_subject = this
			OR = { var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_choice = 1 var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_choice = 2 }
		}
		zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_finalize_m276_effect = yes
		trigger_event = { id = zg361we.5381 days = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_status value = 5 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_status value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_red_code value = 27663 }
	}
}

zg361_we_m276_audit_rehire_finalize_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_status
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_pending = 1
			var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_subject = this
			has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_state
			has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consume_owner
			has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consume_subject
			has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consume_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consume_case
			has_variable = zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consume_choice
			var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_state = 4
			var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consumed = 1
			var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consume_owner = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_owner
			var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consume_subject = this
			var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consume_cycle = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_cycle
			var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consume_case = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_case
			var:zg361_workforce_rehire_fact_consume_choice = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_choice
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_completed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_status value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_pending value = 0 } # completion commit last
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_ad_external_pip_exit_ready
				var:zg361_we_ad_external_pip_exit_ready = 1
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_mode = 2 }
				zg361_we_m277_route_a_effect = {
					TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_owner TICKET_SUBJECT = this
					TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_cycle
					TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_case
				}
			}
			else = {
				var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_we_ad_owner }
				save_scope_as = zg361_we_ad_subject
				save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ad_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_cycle }
				save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ad_case value = var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_case }
				var:zg361_we_m276_rehire_finalize_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361we.277 } }
			}
		}
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_waiting_for_m277_provider value = 1 } }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_status value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_rehire_handoff_red_code value = 27664 }
	}
}
